notes.subject: Future opportunity - Cascades Futurity
notes.body: Current official information places Cascades Futurity & Aged Event at Deschutes County Fairgrounds, 3800 SE Airport Way, Redmond OR. It was discovered while researching events along the leg manager's route. The venue can physically support a large setup, but the event itself is primarily a cutting-horse competition rather than a broad family/community festival, so it is downgraded as an immediate 2026 fit for the leg manager's traveling equipment (2 Pirate's Rebellion units plus 1 Adventure Zone). Use the research as a soft introduction: we noticed the event while looking along the route and would love to be considered for a future event/year if a larger family-entertainment area would ever fit. Official contact page lists Julie Clarke as Show Producer / Show Manager at 503-799-1355; the public source masks the email address, so do not guess an email. No Adventure Zone Gmail history was found. Oregon is weather-restricted, not on hold; prepaid remains preferred if a future opportunity develops.
